items.kw: He Tried To Walk Around The Earth…😳🌍
items.desc: Karl Bushby left his mom's house in 1998 and promised her he wouldn't come back until he walked around the entire planet, with no cars, no boats and no planes. His plan was to walk from the very bottom of South America back home to England in 12 years. But it ended up taking him 28 years. First he had to survive the deadliest jungle on Earth. Then he walked across a frozen ocean into Russia, and got arrested the second he arrived. Then he got trapped in Kazakhstan, with a whole sea blocking his way. So he swam it, for 31 days. And this is the moment he finally keeps his promise to his mom ⚡ Cr

items.kw: A male bird flies thousands of kilometers for 15 years, only to be reunited with his partner.
items.desc: An elderly Croatian man saved a wounded white stork, Malena, who could no longer fly. A male stork, Ak, fell in love with her. Every year, he traveled 16,000 kilometers between South Africa and Europe to reunite with her for fifteen years. When Ak failed to return one spring, the old man wrote to Lebanon’s president. The touching story pushed the country to amend bird-protection laws overnight. Just as everyone lost hope, Ak came back, badly injured but alive.
